trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. No multiplayer and no DLC is needed — everything is in the single-player game. Expect around 200 hours in total, with the 100% completion checklist (A Long Road) the longest single stretch. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the leftover side content, and the platinum pops on the last trophy you earn.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade); PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission in Chapter 1. Just play the opening mission through and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 1 ends, right as the first main mission of Chapter 2 (What's in the Bag?) begins. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing that can be missed: the balcony meditation at Jason's house for Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 2 ends, as the first main mission of Chapter 3 (Welcome to Vice City) begins. Chapter 2 is also when you unlock switching between Jason and Lucia (after the Coffee Break mission) and the Scooter Bros app, so the open world really opens up here.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 3 ends, after the first two main missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach and Another Life). By now you will have unlocked the Key Cloner, the Snap Gun and the fence Yasmani, which open up the robbery trophies.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 4 ends, after its final main mission (Starting From Zero). Once the story is over you keep free-roam of Leonida, and everything the 100% checklist needs is still available.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the story's final mission. The exact chapter the final mission sits in is reported differently by different guides, so this entry does not pin it to a chapter — just finish the story and it pops. After it, the 100% completion checklist appears under Progress, and free-roam continues.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Just follow the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Just follow the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Just follow the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Just follow the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. Just follow the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Just follow the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the longest grind. The 100% checklist unlocks only after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but progress you make during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — closer to 60% true completion. You need any 70 of 80 challenges, any 100 optional missions (there are 200 to 300+), 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, and 300 stunts. The only things that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing toward 100% is missable — everything can be done in free-roam after the story. Do optional missions as they appear (they also teach you the systems), scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study every new animal, and the checklist will be mostly done by the time the story ends.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (100% Completion Checklist)

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps (jumping over ramps), 202 under-the-bridges (flying under bridges), 40 knife flights (flying between buildings) and 25 base jumps (parachute challenges). Mix the kinds however you like — under-the-bridges are the quickest. Track your progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and see each stunt by name on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 and this one comes along for free.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (All Stunt locations)

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check which ones you have done under Touchpad, Progress, Activities. Most of them you will try automatically while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, so do not chase this one early — just check the list late in the game and mop up whichever type is still missing.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. The gold medals are not brutally hard, and the ranges are a good place to level your Focus too (Focus grows by shooting range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots). Work through the ranges steadily rather than in one sitting, and this silver pops well before the end of the 100% checklist, which needs the ranges finished anyway.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (All 12 Shooting Range Locations & 42 Gold Medals)

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). Each location has its own race to win. Drone races also count toward the 100% checklist, which needs them all, so this trophy comes naturally while you work the checklist — just make sure you win at least one race at every location rather than repeating the same easy one.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (All 14 Top Fun Drone Race Locations, 42 Drone Races)

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations. Each location only counts once, so you need to win at 20 separate spots. Races also feed the Master of None activity list, so fold this into your general activity cleanup — pick the easiest race types first and work outward from there.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (All 40 Unique Race Locations)

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will send a text message marking a fishing location with a purple icon on the map, west of Key Lento. Go there and do the fishing challenge against him. Beat Cal and the trophy pops. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable at the TV in your home by interacting with the controllers — you can do this from Chapter 1. Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you like best and play it to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (All 4 Video Game Locations)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is exclusive to Lucia and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3. At some point while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Finish her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (join the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van), and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). The last one unlocks the trophy. All of Andy's quests stay available after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline gets marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the Chapter 1 main mission Island Dreams (work for Kenton), he calls you and gets marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving at shipwrecks — purple treasure chest icons on the map — where you use a metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back to him. In total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees, and Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures. Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2 to 3 (calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up), so this is not missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests: Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (join Billy on a job), Mall Rats (join Billy on a job), The Impaler (steal the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes (join Billy on a job). The last one unlocks the trophy. All of Billy's quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers in the open world. Only certain questlines count — the game does not count Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy or Eddie toward this trophy. Confirmed to count: Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests — Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago — do it when it appears, it is part of this strand — Brother to Brother), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries, Deliver Packages). More stranger strands are still being discovered, so this entry marks the list as partly unconfirmed. All strangers stay available after the story in free-roam, and you can see how many strands you have finished in the trophy tracker.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Strangers & Freaks)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. Deliver a sports car to Randy and he hands you a list of 16 sports cars he wants. Track them under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List. He marks some cars for you in fixed locations, but you can also steal them off the street — scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on the list, then drive it back to his garage (green RK icon, west of Vice City). Delivering in good condition pays more. The cars turn up often in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. This can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go to the labs and destroy them (the quest Take Out Kitty Litter). Once you have destroyed enough labs, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This (shut down the labs), and finishing it unlocks the trophy. All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the only trophy that might be missed, so do this first. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts as +2. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. The catch: one meditation is at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and it goes away for good when Chapter 1 ends. After the Chapter 1 main mission Down to Earth, go back to Jason's house in the morning and talk to Lucia in the kitchen — she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you get an optional quest popup. Talk to her on the balcony and choose Accept, then complete the meditation. Whether that Chapter 1 meditation is actually required for the trophy is still unconfirmed: it raises your counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, and the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations. Do it anyway — it costs nothing and removes the risk. You cannot do the final meditation until you can play both characters together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Make a manual save before leaving Chapter 1, just in case.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (All 18 Meditation Spot Locations); KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap; HappyGamer — GTA 6 Missables

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline gets marked after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. While playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that starts his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive the message, so this strand is Jason-only. During that first quest Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, which you can pick up again from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. Afterward he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map: hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. Track it under Map, Activities, Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks in total, and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes along naturally. Which exact animal unlocks this trophy is still being confirmed, so this entry marks it unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations in total, so you have plenty to choose from — pick the three sets whose cards are closest together and finish those first. Card sets are a collectible type, so they are also worth doing for general completion, and nothing about them is missable.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (All 18 Collectible Card Set Locations)

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then hold R1 on an object). There are far more than 100 scannable spots, and any 100 count: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Just scan things as you pass them while doing everything else — landmarks in the city, curiosities out in the countryside — and this pops on its own long before you have seen the whole map.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this trophy unlocks automatically on the way there. Track them under Progress, Challenges — the completed checkmark in the bottom right shows your count. Most challenges finish naturally while you work on the other trophies, so leave this for late in the game and then pick the easiest and quickest of the ones you still have left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (All 80 Challenges)

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: The earliest you can do this is after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together as Jason and Lucia — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level (just cause carnage until you reach 4 stars), then escape. The best way out is a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic to get out of the search area; if a helicopter is chasing you, shoot at it until it leaves. The easiest escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — the cops struggle to follow you on the train tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy unlocks after you drive out of the red heat wanted zone, not just the flashing search area. It also unlocks automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, and while robbing the large bank vaults for the 100% checklist, which always trigger 4-star wanted levels.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Hit 3 robbery targets (green icons on the map) in a row while being chased by the police the whole time — you must keep the red and blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs (bought at Ammu-Nations) and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing, and call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Loot 3 shops in a row; if it does not unlock after the third, hit a fourth and keep going. The unlock is delayed — it pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City (available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): rob a couple of items in each store, go into the back room and break the safe with sticky bombs. If you leave the first store before the police arrive, you may need a fourth store.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles out of the 557 in the game at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). The fastest way is the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly): look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Stand at a busy road and scan everything that drives past — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. You need 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes automatically on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots on enemies are highlighted, and it drains the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. You must kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in a single use, but the focus only lasts a few seconds. Prepare first: buff your focus with food, drinks, or washing your face and showering at home, and consume Adrenaline to extend the focus time (hold L1, then press Triangle). Line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations are ideal — and drop them quickly without missing. Wear body armor (bought at Ammu-Nations) so you can step out of cover, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556, which is full-auto and more accurate than pistols and SMGs. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (check Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, Focus, the purple eye icon); it grows by doing shooting range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots. By the time you have worked through the other trophies you will be at Focus level 4, and this one often pops naturally.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). It has to be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge — the planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through one of the fences around the airfield and head straight for it; next to the boarding bridge are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane (you can also walk in through the airport terminal). Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The unlock is a little delayed, so keep flying until it pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. You find them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance. Climb in, shoot some enemies, and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies (green icons in unfogged map areas). Break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun — do not kick the door, that triggers the alarm. The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently and needs no equipping. In the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, and be sure to destroy the security footage and disable the alarm while you are there. The trophy unlocks shortly after you leave the store. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (wait at the cafe) — it is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank vault robberies. Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase of cash into the bank and the vault opens: go in while it is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash yourself, so bring your partner and hold Right to hand off a bag. After that quest you can pay Yasmani (the fence from Chapter 3) for tips about security vans — $10,000 a tip, and you must have done his earlier quests (robbing 2 Payday Loans) first. Robbing a bank vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level: escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch to another vehicle to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total; you need any 5 for this trophy and all 8 for the 100% checklist. A single bank can pay up to $205,000, the best endgame money in the game.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (All 8 Bank Vault Locations)

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, the same mission that opens bank vault robberies: tail the armored truck to the bank, the guard carries the cash to the vault, enter the vault, steal the cash and escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). You need all 8 large bank jobs for the 100% checklist, so this comes along for free. If you want it earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up. The trophy only unlocks after you escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani himself is unlocked as a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area that is still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. Do this late in the game, when you have already been most places for the story and the other trophies, so there is less fog left to clear.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN count); PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations in total. For this trophy you only need to rob one operation belonging to each gang; for the 100% checklist you need all 39, so this unlocks automatically on the way. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track your progress under Progress, Gangs — scroll over a gang and the bottom right shows how many of their operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (All Illegal Gang Operation Locations)

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view in front of you, and the trophy pops. One of the quickest trophies in the list — do it whenever you are passing Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (steal the Zorrusso for Randy). Hack into the car, drive forward through the window, and keep driving a little further down the street — the unlock is slightly delayed. Only this blue Banshee counts, not any other car: it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, one of the gang operations in Port Gellhorn. Before you go, buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow up the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which gets marked automatically in Chapter 2. Inside the bowling alley, pick up: the luxury watch in the office in the south-east (golden icon), the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon), and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway (blow it up with sticky bombs). The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not the moment you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. If you do not get all 3 items during the optional mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while — go back later and steal the remaining valuables. Not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check your strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, scroll to Strength (the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Increase strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club. Always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner): while one character actively works out, the other automatically completes their training, so you make double the progress. Filter for fitness clubs on Map, Activities (the dumbbell icon) — there are lots of them all over Vice City. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. You can see your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On): whenever you do something that affects your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right side of the screen. The profiles are Professional (finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them, for example shooting them in the limbs), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, or driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable (a permanent status from excessive violence — avoid it, because cops will shoot you on sight). This happens passively while you work on all the other trophies and the 100% checklist, since every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If it still is not done when everything else is, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car — but that pushes your profile toward Psycho and Irredeemable, so only do it at the very end.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN count); PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — this trophy is currently unknown. The leading belief is that it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue: possibly robbing it again later, in a specific manner, in Vice City, Little Cuba. No guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet, so do not build your run around this one — check the sources listed here again closer to your playthrough, and treat anything else you read about it as a rumor until a second source agrees.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and come solo. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is there, you can trigger the UFO; if it is not, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her and offer to help; she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed, so be patient and retry.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Drive any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach, where there are always people on the sidewalks. Ride slowly along a busy street, kicking pedestrians as you pass — ten kicks inside one minute pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) — that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, which lets you launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). You need $250,000 delivered in total, and it counts across all robberies — you do not need to bring it all at once. This comes naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist. The bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery within a few minutes, but they only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all types of shops. The fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos, since those are the most expensive things in the game. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — just buy what you actually want while playing and this pops on its own, or dump money into car mods at the end if you are still short.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more story-related garages, but only the 8 purchasable ones count). Together they cost $160,000. Garages become available for purchase after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses) — you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed on your phone. Buy the garages through the phone app. A quick way to make the money is robberies, especially later in Chapters 3 and 4 when the higher-value robberies open up.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (All 12 Garage Locations)

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location wherever you are. To register 10 vehicles you need enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds one or more parking spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click Respray and then Register. Moses initially only accepts vehicles without trackers; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes if you want to keep expenses down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
